Body skin and blemishes · Current person
AI blemish candidates are grouped by color and scale, not by a dedicated mole / spot / sweat classifier. Preview first and erase false selections. New strengths default to 0.

Select the corresponding area in Masks and edit with Add / Subtract brushes. Regeneration replaces that type's selection and can be undone. Strength changes reuse AI results; enlarged selections need another application. Natural dark nostril areas are not repaired automatically.

Body-specific controls add to basic retouching and default to 0. Basic smoothing and whitening still cover body skin. These smoothing, whitening and tone controls apply directly; blemish, dark-spot and tattoo repair require the AI button below. Automatic areas exclude clothing; manual additions protect other people.

Tattoo candidates use color / contrast rules. Confirm them with preview and brushes before LaMa fills them. Stretch-mark and collarbone controls use fine-line / pose-based lighting within skin. They remain experimental because matching real samples have not been validated.
